help.lead: MindAtlas turns thoughts into cards and arranges them by meaning. Change the axes and the same cards stretch into a new shape.
help.step1: Create cards: double-click empty space, paste text, or drop files.
help.step2: Cards are placed by meaning along the X/Y/Z axes. Drag one to where you think it belongs — that becomes its value on those axes.
help.step3: Change axes from the axes window, or drop any card onto the gold frame at the end of an axis to make it the axis.
help.step4: Select cards to open the ring of actions: summary, child card, ask, bundle, expand, extract and organize.
help.depth: Move in depth (Z): away is up and to the right, and smaller
help.paste: Paste text, URL or image as cards
help.privacy: Your spaces are stored in this browser. When signed in, they also sync to your account. Card text is sent to the server to compute embeddings.
